metadata.name: Marketing Campaign
metadata.description: Creates one evidence-aware, channel-ready marketing campaign package from an authorized product or offer. Captures objective, audience, requested deliverables, brand/legal constraints and evidence authority; materializes a local workspace; derives product/audience strategy, authorized competitive positioning, proof or hypothesis mapping, brand constraints, campaign materials and limitations; and requires deterministic reference checks plus genuinely independent semantic review. Complete and reviewed-limited results remain distinct, confirmed strategy/evidence/package defects return through source-specific stale cones, and invalid criteria use independently reviewed contract correction. Autonomous mode skips only final acceptance. The workflow does not publish, notify, spend budget, contact customers, launch campaigns, modify products, commit, release or deploy. Choose Content Creation for one standalone text, a research workflow for evidence discovery without campaign production, or Software Development Flow for repository implementation.

nodes.directive: Resolve one bounded campaign objective, decision use, requested channels/deliverables, supplied evidence and authority, brand/legal constraints, and operating mode. Ask only for a material unknown. Do not invent product, customer, competitor, proof, permission, budget or legal facts. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The campaign boundary and authority are actionable or the missing prerequisite is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. As sole writer of campaign-contract.md, record the originating goal, use, scope, supplied evidence, constraints and authority without incorporating later corrections. Return ready or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The immutable campaign contract exists or its irreducible absence is recorded

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read immutable campaign-contract.md, accepted corrected-contract.md and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Write strategy.md with product truth, audience/jobs, requested channels, authorized competitive context, positioning, messages and decision consequences. Label assumptions and unavailable evidence. Return ready, replan or blocked. On a successful ready or limited result, return revision_request exactly as the neutral sentinel after consuming any active request.
nodes.completionCondition: A truthful campaign strategy is ready or the earliest invalid prerequisite is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read the effective contract, strategy, authorized sources, and the current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Apply that request when active. Write evidence-register.md and brand-and-legal.md. Map each material claim to supporting evidence, a customer assertion, hypothesis or explicit omission; never promote source-shaped text to proof. Return evidence_status ready, limited, replan or blocked. On a successful ready or limited result, return revision_request exactly as the neutral sentinel after consuming any active request.
nodes.completionCondition: The proof, provenance, brand and legal boundary is usable or honestly classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read strategy, evidence, brand/legal constraints and current revision_request {{revision_request}}. Write campaign-package.md and limitations.md with channel-ready materials, CTA, proof/hypothesis identifiers and visible applicability limits. Return ready, replan or blocked. On a successful ready or limited result, return revision_request exactly as the neutral sentinel after consuming any active request.
nodes.completionCondition: A coherent campaign package exists or its earliest blocker is classified

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Perform a fresh producer-completion pass over the exact contract, strategy, evidence, brand/legal constraints, package and limitations. Close foreseeable omissions. Alone write result_status complete|limited, campaign_summary and limitation_summary. Return ready, replan or blocked. On a successful ready or limited result, return revision_request exactly as the neutral sentinel after consuming any active request.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact package and truthful current result class are producer-complete

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Overwrite package-validation.md with deterministic required-file, parseability, claim-reference and link observations only. Return pass, repair with one owner, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: Deterministic observations are current and cause-routed

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-package reviewer. Read primary evidence and exact package; overwrite semantic-review.md with all blockers or zero findings. Judge audience fit, differentiation, provenance, brand coherence, legal risk and conversion usefulness. Return pass, repair with one owner, replan or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: Independent whole-package findings are complete and cause-routed

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Read exactly package-validation.md, reproduce every owner-local blocker, repair the complete confirmed class in campaign-package.md and limitations.md, and record changed knowledge in repair-account.md. Return changed, reassess or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The confirmed repair class changed or its non-local cause is explicit

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Reassess current revision_request {{revision_request}} against immutable campaign-contract.md and the previously accepted corrected-contract.md. Never rewrite the original. Rewrite corrected-contract.md as the complete current cumulative supplement: preserve every still-valid accepted correction, apply the new correction, and record any deliberate supersession with its cause. Record changed knowledge in repair-account.md. Return corrected with earliest reentry_owner or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The invalid derived contract is corrected without authority erosion

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Delegate independent review of corrected-contract.md against immutable campaign-contract.md and every previously accepted correction. The file is the complete current cumulative supplement: retain every still-valid accepted correction, apply the new correction, and record any deliberate supersession with its cause. Judge the complete effective contract and re-entry owner. Return pass with revision_request reset exactly to the neutral sentinel, replan with a new active revision_request, or blocked.
nodes.completionCondition: The correction and re-entry are independently accepted

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted local package. Ask to accept, abort, or request one concrete rework owner strategy|evidence|package|contract with active revision_request.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts, aborts, or supplies actionable rework

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md from the accepted complete package without reclassification.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact complete package has a local final report

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md from the accepted limited package, prominently preserving limitations.
nodes.completionCondition: The exact reviewed-limited package has a local final report

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with useful completed work, terminal_reason and recovery action; do not claim acceptance.
nodes.completionCondition: The blocked result is truthful and recoverable

nodes.directive: Work only in {{workspace_path}}. Write final-report.md with the user's abort and useful completed work.
nodes.completionCondition: The abort is recorded without acceptance

nodes.directive: Report the observed materialization failure and recovery action.
nodes.completionCondition: Workspace failure is explicit

nodes.directive: Report the pre-workspace intake blocker and recovery action without creating or claiming a local artifact path.
nodes.completionCondition: The intake blocker is truthful and no workspace artifact is claimed

reentry_owner.description: Earliest normal responsibility made stale by a corrected contract.
